decision.why: The parent reduced measured chord error from 30/38 to 25/38, but melody error rose to 100% and none of seven files parsed. Its missing melody dependency makes integration repair more informative than further OCR tuning. Three experiments remain. The parent executed successfully and was evaluated, so this is an improve branch; the previous debug request was rejected. Preserve the baseline as the stronger measured melody comparator.
decision.hypothesis: Fresh melody recognition plus independently validated serialization can recover the baseline's melody performance while retaining some of the parent's measured chord improvement.
decision.expected_observation: Parseability increases and melody error falls below the parent's 100%; chord error remains near 25/38. Failure to obtain parseable outputs or a melody improvement would falsify this integration approach within the available runtime. Even success would leave full-dataset accuracy, chord timing and musician acceptance unresolved.

config.approach: Retain the parent's image-derived chord OCR and replace its unavailable-baseline dependency with fresh enlarged-image melody recognition and validated kern serialization.
config.objective: On the same seven pilot images, first inspect the parent serializer and determine why protected evaluation found zero parseable outputs despite its local checks. Run Audiveris on enlarged images in this container, installing required dependencies within the worker budget, and convert actual recognized melody into kern. Integrate the existing chord OCR without changing its recognition thresholds. Do not assume prior baseline artifacts exist, substitute dummy melody, or infer missing notes from musical plausibility. Validate complete files with an independent kern reader and report explicit failures if recognition or conversion cannot be completed. Preserve chord bounding boxes and flag onset alignment as unaudited.
config.success_criteria: Submit sealed predictions and per-image recognition, conversion and independent parsing diagnostics for all seven inputs. Target seven parseable files and melody error no worse than the enlarged Audiveris baseline of 87/130 errors. Compare protected chord error against both the parent's 25/38 errors and baseline's 30/38; report any regressions rather than assuming OCR gains survive integration. Test upward-major-second transposition on actual generated melody, chord roots and slash basses, separating structural checks from transcription correctness. Retain raw recognition outputs and document missing dependencies or runtime limits.

last_observation.summary: Integration failed within budget. Retained parent chord OCR unchanged and implemented fresh Audiveris execution, melody conversion and validation paths. Java/native-library startup failures prevented MusicXML exports for all seven images; all seven outputs are explicitly marked failure placeholders, with no invented melody. Complete-file parsing and transposition on recognized melody could not be tested. Per-image diagnostics record these failures. Parent checks validated syntax and synthetic examples rather than complete generated transcriptions; the exact protected-reader failure remains unconfirmed. Chord onset alignment remains unaudited. Protected error comparisons are unavailable, so no improvement or non-regression is claimed. Goal unmet.

observation.note: Frozen worker output; only protected evaluation measures accuracy.
